title: Putnami Events Push Delivery Receiver Contract
description: Provider push wrapper POSTed to a subscriber-hosted receiver endpoint (the conventional route is POST /_putnami/events/:subscription). The receiver authenticates the request out-of-band via an OIDC bearer token (audience-pinned, minted as the events-server service account) verified against the provider JWKS with an issuer + audience + service-account-email allowlist, fail-closed — never via a field in this body. An HTTP 2xx acknowledges delivery; 4xx dead-letters the message; any other status is retried by the provider. Push delivery is at-least-once, so receivers must be idempotent.

ackOutcome.description: Receiver HTTP status to delivery outcome mapping: 2xx=ack, 4xx=dlq, otherwise=retry.
